entry_time_confirmation.rule: At the frozen baseline scalp_snap signal close, use the last two consecutive complete 5s microstructure buckets available before next-bar entry. Require previous aggressive trade-flow sign to equal the initiating drive direction, current aggressive trade-flow sign to flip to the intended reversal side, and current top20 book-imbalance sign to align with the intended reversal side.

falsification: On a fresh prospective boundary, the exhaustion-confirmed version fails to improve cost-adjusted expectancy and PF versus the frozen baseline under the same realistic cost authority, or any apparent improvement is attributable only to outcome-conditioned trade deletion / inadequate retention.
